script: In 2013, NASA's Curiosity rover sang Happy Birthday to itself on Mars. It used vibrations from its soil sample instrument to play the tune. Curiosity is about the size of a car. It runs on heat from a nuclear power source instead of solar panels. It has been exploring Mars since 2012. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
